Indran Standard 

DIMENSIONS FOR FERROUS VALVES — FACE-TO-fACE 

AND END-TO-END 



1. Scope — Covers face-to-face and centre-to-face dimensions of flanged valves, as well as end-to- 
end and centre-to-end dimensions of butt welding end valves, to permit a degree of dimensional 
interchangeability. 

2. Pressure Rating — The range of pressure rating is Class 125 — 150 — 250— 300— 600 — 900 

— 1500 and 2500. 

3. Nominal Sire — The range of nominal size in DN values is 10 — 15 — 20 — 25 — 32* — 40 — 50 

— 65* — 80— 100 — 125 — 150 — 200 — 250-300 — 350 — 400 — 450 — 500 — 600— 700 — 800 — 900 
— 1000. 

4. Terminology 

4.1 Face-to-Face Dimensions ( for Straight Pattern Valves) — The distance, expressed in millimetres, 
between the two planes perpendicular to the valve axis located at the extremities of the body end 
ports as specified in Tables 1 to 4. 

4.2 Centre-to-Face Dimensions (for Angle Pattern Valves) — The distance expressed in millimetres, 
between the plane located at the extremity of either body end port and perpendicular to its axis and 
the other body end port axis. 

4.3 E$d-to-End Dimensions (for Straight Pattern Valves) — The distance, expressed in millimetres, 
between the two planes perpendicular to the valve axis located at the root faces of the welding lips. 

4.4 Centre-to-End Dimensions (for Angle Pattern Valves) — The distance, expressed in millimetres, 
between the plane located at the root faces and perpendicular to its axis and the other body end 
port axis. 

5. Standard Facings 

5.1 The face-to-face dimensions given in the tables are for valves having the standard facings as 
indicated below: 

a) Plain flat face — CI.125 cast iron valves. 

b) 1-6 mm raised face — CI.250 cast iron valves, CI.150, CI. 300 steel valves. 

c) 6'4 mm raised face - CI.600, CI.900, CI. 1500, CI.2500 steel valves. 
Face-to-face dimensions given in tables are inclusive of the raised face thicknesses. 




7. Dimensions and Tolerances — The face-to-face or centre-to-face and end-to-end or 
centre-to-end, as appropriate, for the valves included in this Indian Standard shall be in 
accordance with Tables 1 to 5 and tolerances shall be in accordance with Table 6. 



♦Non-preferred sizes. 



Adopted 23 July 1981

APPENDIX A 

( Clause 6 ) 

ADDITIONAL LENGTHS FOR VALVES WITH RING JOINT FLANGES 



-0.5A+0.5X 

A — the raised face flange face-to-face dimensions. 

For parallel flanged valves the following values of X must be added to the raised face flange 
face-to-face dimensions for flanges suitable for octogonal section or oval ring section ring joints. 
For angle pattern valves, one-half of the value X must be added to the dimensions for centre of 
valve body-to-raised faced dimensions.
